custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView").
  • Stay in one location for the whole case. It is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919").
  • Three active technicians at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard), [Tech-B] (e.g. Ralph Edwards) and [Tech-C] (e.g. Dana Ortiz).
  • One Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], with two lines that have no technician of their own (they follow the lead). Use one you already have, e.g. the work order of customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History", or make one as below.

To make the work order (only if you need one)

  1. Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick any customer and its asset > Save.
  2. Add two lines (New Line). On each line leave the technicians empty and set Status to "Authorized" (this makes the work order Approved).
  3. On the work order's left card set Lead Technician to [Tech-A].
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab, then click Board View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar.
  2. Click Search and type the customer's name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History").
  3. Note the time. Drag [WO-1]'s card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column. If the question "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" opens, click Keep Shifts.
  4. Click the work order number on the card to open the work order.
  5. Open the WORK ORDER's log: click the ⋮ (three dots) at the top right of the work order, next to New Line, then click Audit Log. The "Work Order Log" opens. Lead technician changes are recorded here, not in a line's own Audit log (the menu under a line's number).
  6. In the Work Order Log, count the "Lead tech changed" entries added by your change and read their Details (e.g. "Lead tech: Esther Howard → Ralph Edwards"), User and Time. Close the log with its x.
  7. On the Lines tab click the first line's name to open Edit Line. Set Technicians to [Tech-C] (remove the technician shown with its x, then pick [Tech-C] in Add Technician) and click Save & Close.
  8. Open that line's own log: click the line's number (1), then Audit log, and read the newest entries. Close it.
  9. Repeat steps 3 to 6 using More actions on the card > Reassign lead technician ([Tech-B] → [Tech-A]), then once more by changing Lead Technician on the work order's left card ([Tech-A] → [Tech-B]). Each time, read the Work Order Log (step 5).
